module: Prepares the off-screen render format: creates the RenderFormatToken "AL_FormatToken" (color R8G8B8A8, depth $GFXFormatDefaultDepth or D24S8, aaLevel 0, disabled at the start), the state block "AL_FormatTokenState" (inherits from PFX_DefaultStateBlock, sampler SamplerClampPoint) and the PostEffect "AL_FormatCopy" (passthrough to $backbuffer). This token is enabled/disabled by the light managers.
notes: The objects AL_FormatTokenState and AL_FormatCopy are created on module import, outside initRenderManager; AL_FormatToken is created on each call of initRenderManager (no existence test).

initRenderManager.desc: Creates and registers the RenderFormatToken object "AL_FormatToken" (disabled) with AL_FormatCopy as the copy and resolve effect.
